title: Smarter heroes and a tap-to-command menu
problem: Heroes sometimes stop moving after an order (a bug), the owner wants smarter heroes, and wants commanding to be: tap the hero, pick from a few options, then tap where to go or what to attack.
scope: Fix heroes stalling after orders: heroes pass through their own troops; head-on bumps slide past instead of locking

Smarter heroes: wait outside an enemy tower until own troops are there; fall back to their own tower when badly hurt while pushing; better target choice (enemy heroes in reach, then the weakest); an on-screen note when a hero is waiting or falling back
Attack order: chase and hit a chosen visible enemy, then return to the previous job
Command menu: tap a hero panel or a hero on the map, pick an order, tap a highlighted target; Cancel; drag-to-order kept as a shortcut
Re-check balance (npm run balance), tests, phone check, help text, docs, records
exclusions: Aiming ultimates by hand (they still fire at the best moment once called)

acceptance.text: No stalls: in 60 matches of random player orders, no hero stands still without a reason (detector); collision rules tested
acceptance.evidence: Stall detector (player gives random orders every 3 s, 60 matches): before the fix 14 real stalls (heroes shoved back by their own wave; head-on deadlocks with teammates); after: 0. Now a permanent soak test (SOAK stalls: 0). ai.test.ts: a hero walks through its own troops; two heroes walking at each other pass.

acceptance.text: Smarter heroes: tower-dive wait, fall back when hurt, target choice (automated tests)
acceptance.evidence: tests/ai.test.ts: waits outside an enemy tower (unhurt) until own troops are in its reach, then attacks it; falls back home below 25% health, heals to 80%, returns to its lane; picks an enemy hero in reach over a nearer troop.

acceptance.text: Attack order: chases a visible enemy, refuses unseen or invalid targets, returns to its job after (automated)
acceptance.evidence: tests/ai.test.ts: Attack chases and kills a chosen visible enemy then returns to Push; refuses an enemy in the fog and a troop Gergasi can't hit; a camp becomes Farm; stops when the enemy vanishes into the fog.

acceptance.text: Command menu: select, choose, highlighted targets, tap to order, cancel, for every order (browser check)
acceptance.evidence: phone-check: tapping a panel opens the menu; Farm (grove), Ward (cairn), Move (open spot), Push (tap anywhere on a lane), Attack (tap an enemy ring), Retreat (instant), Cancel, tap the hero on the map, and the drag shortcut all work; PHONE CHECK OK; screenshots checked.

acceptance.text: Balance still in the PLAN-005 targets; determinism; soak
acceptance.evidence: npm run balance (1,200 matches): species 46-56%, heroes 43-59%, draws 11%, decided before 2:30: 3; determinism 4/4; soak 100 + 20 matches; 93/93 unit tests.
Not yet tried on the owner's phone.

acceptance.text: Owner's verdict: heroes smart enough? commanding intuitive?

risks: Heroes acting on their own (waiting, falling back) can feel like disobeying; shown on screen
Smarter bot heroes shift balance: re-checked
The menu adds a tap compared with dragging; dragging stays as a shortcut
cost: RM0. Free tools; private preview page. Several build sessions (estimate).
userNotes: Fixed: heroes no longer stop after an order (they were being pushed back by their own troops or locking up with a teammate).
Command menu: tap a hero, pick Move, Attack, Push, Gank, Defend, Farm, Ward or Retreat, then tap a highlighted target.
New Attack order: send a hero after an enemy you can see.
Smarter heroes: they wait for their troops before walking under an enemy tower, go home to heal when badly hurt, and go for enemy heroes first.

approval.evidence: make it so that heroes are smarter, now currently the heroes would suddenly stop moving after commands are given ... make the instruction for heroes more intuitive, it should be player clicking on the hero's icon, select a few available option, and target where to go/what to aim etc etc
